# Afghan Cuisine and Charcoal Kebab House

## About

Afghan Cuisine and Charcoal Kebab House is a restaurant located at 327 Prospect Road, Blair Athol, South Australia 5084. It serves traditional Afghan food cooked over real hardwood charcoal.

The restaurant is halal certified and welcomes dine-in customers and takeaway orders. Delivery is available through Uber Eats; pickup orders are placed by phone.

## Cuisine

The restaurant specialises in authentic Afghan cuisine. Signature dishes include:

- Charcoal-grilled kebabs: chicken, lamb, lamb mince and mixed skewer platters
- Kabuli Pulao: Afghanistan's national dish of slow-cooked basmati rice with lamb, caramelised carrots and raisins
- Manto: steamed Afghan dumplings filled with savory onion and tender lamb mince, topped with garlicky yogurt sauce and served with daal
- Biryani: aromatic rice layered with slow-cooked meat and Afghan spices
- BBQ Chicken: half chicken grilled over charcoal
- Freshly baked Afghan bread
- Traditional sides including Dal (lentil curry) and Chole (chickpea curry)
- Desserts including Baklava and Jalebi
